findings.rootCause: Tapping the menu button ("Menu") took 376 ms to respond in the lab test — Google's 'good' limit for INP is 200 ms.

evidence.statement: Lab test — measured by simulating a tap on a mid-range phone (4× slower CPU).
Menu button "Menu" (button.menu-toggle): 376 ms total — 18 ms waiting to start (input delay), 357 ms running the page's code (processing), 1 ms drawing the result (presentation).
Script app.js (ceez-11.github.io) ran for 351 ms during this interaction (started by BUTTON.onclick).
Other slow interactions in the same test: Accordion "How do I apply?" 320 ms; Accordion "When is rent due?" 320 ms; Button "Do you allow pets?" 320 ms.
4 interaction(s) tested in total. Real users' INP (Google field data) can differ from this lab result.

findings.recommendation: Most of the wait (357 ms) was the page's own code reacting to the tap — the click handler itself is slow. Do only the visible change first (open the menu, show the panel) and move the rest to later, break big pieces of work into smaller chunks, and yield back to the browser between them (for example with scheduler.yield() or setTimeout). The script doing the most work during this interaction was app.js (ceez-11.github.io).
